title: Button-Zipper Lab
shareTitle: Button-Zipper Lab — Four Tactile Fastener Games
description: Zip, button, snap, peel, and smooth four cozy felt fasteners with a friendly bear. Earn a stitched patch for each three-round fine-motor challenge.
learningGoals: Coordinate a steadying hand with a moving hand
Follow straight and curved paths with controlled finger movement
Practice zipper, button, snap, and hook-and-loop fastener motions
Build persistence and confidence with everyday dressing skills
interactionModel: drag one oversized raster fastener along a constrained stitched path, with optional two-finger support, press-and-hold, two-phase peel-and-smooth, and a complete tap fallback
feedbackModel: the felt object tracks the child's motion, snaps to forgiving checkpoints, gives gentle narrated hints without failure, and awards persistent stitched patches after three successful rounds

modes.title: Zipper
modes.skill: two-hand stabilization and controlled upward pulling

modes.title: Button
modes.skill: curved path following and buttonhole alignment

modes.title: Snap
modes.skill: alignment followed by sustained or repeated pressure

modes.title: Hook & Loop
modes.skill: peeling away and smoothing back across
